queries.name: tipos_columnas_sql
queries.sql:
SELECT
    t.name AS tabla,
    c.name AS columna,
    ty.name AS tipo_sql,
    c.max_length,
    c.is_nullable
FROM sys.schemas s
JOIN sys.tables t ON t.schema_id = s.schema_id
JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id = t.object_id
JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id = c.user_type_id
WHERE s.name = 'dbo'
AND (
    (t.name = 'Unidades_Negocio'
     AND c.name IN ('id','codigo','server_id','activo'))
 OR (t.name = 'Sistema_Empresas'
     AND c.name IN ('EmpresaID','CodigoEmpresa','Activo'))
 OR (t.name = 'Sync_Productos'
     AND c.name IN ('ProductoID','UnidadNegocioID','ServerID'))
 OR (t.name = 'Sync_Productos_Insumos'
     AND c.name IN ('InsumoID','ServerID'))
 OR (t.name = 'Sync_Productos_Recetas'
     AND c.name IN ('RecetaDetalleID','ServerID','Activo'))
)
ORDER BY t.name, c.name

objective: Verificar tipos SQL de identificadores de unidades, empresas, productos, insumos y recetas. Solo metadatos.
